guarantees: V1-V6 are immutable; V7 is additive only.
Every profile classification parses and validates the full known Lite prototype source; a current-profile tag is never trusted.
Reconciliation persists source and target digests without rewriting definitions, releases, answers, mutation responses, submission envelopes, or respondent hashes.
Unsupported and relationship-quarantined records cascade to dependent compatibility state without inferred links; session/release and submission/session form mismatches retain both sides as evidence.

New bearer secrets differ from V3 placeholders and are stored only as digests; reconciliation does not hash legacy rows, and authorization uses retained-token verification plus atomic null-only backfill.
Publish and public session start require the writable non-normative M1 profile and reject quarantined records.
